```
['create a LocobotGymEnv instance to simulate a locobot arm in a PyBullet gym environment', 'reset the LocobotGymEnv episode to get initial joint angles and a random goal position', 'step the LocobotGymEnv with an action array to move arm joints toward the goal', 'review the LocobotGymEnv _detect_collision method that checks contact points for self-collision', 'summarize the LocobotGymEnv _cal_reward method that computes distance-based reward from end-effector to goal']
```
